node.title: Re^2: Terminology: Is DBIx::Class an ORM?
node.author: haj
node.doctext:
I've always thought that since DBIx::Class Maps an Object-oritented data structure to a Relational database, it's an ORM :-)

Uh-oh... I always found it easy to map an existing relational database to [mod://DBIx::Class] objects using the [mod://DBIx::Class::Schema::Loader] and, also often cumbersome to map my object structures to a RDBMS if it wasn't designed for a relational database in the first place.
